item.content:encoded:
It was hopefully planning to be, yes. :3

ETA: I'm thinking about basing it on the five stages of grief, with this being 'acceptance'. They'll all involve different anomalies of varying importance - as subtle as a this shadow, to something more dramatic - and will be linked together not only in theme, but by the connection to each character.

I may change what I base the series on, however, so I'm open to suggestions. It really depends if people want to see more of Laurel, who is well-developed in my mind, or if people are happy reading about different characters in each story.
